## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The schema validates a fixture ledger containing variable and control facts,...

The system SHALL ensure that the schema validates a fixture ledger containing variable and control facts, a derived signal, and a cited hypothesis.

#### Scenario: The schema validates a fixture ledger containing variable and control facts,...

WHEN `define-evidence-ledger-schema-with-immutable-facts` is implemented
THEN The schema validates a fixture ledger containing variable and control facts, a derived signal, and a cited hypothesis.

### Requirement: The validator rejects a ledger revision in which a previously recorded...

The system SHALL ensure that the validator rejects a ledger revision in which a previously recorded fact's fields were edited in place, and accepts the same dispute expressed as a reverify_request plus a new fact.

#### Scenario: The validator rejects a ledger revision in which a previously recorded...

WHEN `define-evidence-ledger-schema-with-immutable-facts` is implemented
THEN The validator rejects a ledger revision in which a previously recorded fact's fields were edited in place, and accepts the same dispute expressed as a reverify_request plus a new fact.

### Requirement: Signals are classified as signal or noise and each references exactly one...

The system SHALL ensure that signals are classified as signal or noise and each references exactly one variable fact and one control fact.

#### Scenario: Signals are classified as signal or noise and each references exactly one...

WHEN `define-evidence-ledger-schema-with-immutable-facts` is implemented
THEN Signals are classified as signal or noise and each references exactly one variable fact and one control fact.

### Requirement: Validator tests live under skills/tests/ and resolve any OpenSpec paths via...

The system SHALL ensure that validator tests live under skills/tests/ and resolve any OpenSpec paths via change_dir().

#### Scenario: Validator tests live under skills/tests/ and resolve any OpenSpec paths via...

WHEN `define-evidence-ledger-schema-with-immutable-facts` is implemented
THEN Validator tests live under skills/tests/ and resolve any OpenSpec paths via change_dir().
